title: Missing values
hypothesis: Key nulls are quarantined, others are handled without losing rows; PR-AUC declines gradually with the null rate; a cleaning plan affecting more than 5% of rows waits for approval.
conclusion: PR-AUC on the sealed test split by non-key null rate (keys 1% throughout): nulls_0pct_nonkey=0.6338 [0.5875, 0.6817], nulls_5pct_nonkey=0.6419 [0.5963, 0.6901], nulls_20pct_nonkey=0.6391 [0.5924, 0.6841], nulls_50pct_nonkey=0.6351 [0.5905, 0.6841]. Monotone decline: False. Calibration error: nulls_0pct_nonkey=0.0283, nulls_5pct_nonkey=0.0364, nulls_20pct_nonkey=0.0287, nulls_50pct_nonkey=0.0225. Key nulls quarantined by the key rule, of those injected: nulls_0pct_nonkey 391/391, nulls_5pct_nonkey 391/391, nulls_20pct_nonkey 391/391, nulls_50pct_nonkey 391/391, nulls_key_10pct_over_limit 3901/3901. Non-key nulls injected: nulls_0pct_nonkey 0, nulls_5pct_nonkey 5853, nulls_20pct_nonkey 23274, nulls_50pct_nonkey 58476, nulls_key_10pct_over_limit 0. Rows affected: nulls_0pct_nonkey 1.0077%, nulls_5pct_nonkey 1.0077%, nulls_20pct_nonkey 1.0077%, nulls_50pct_nonkey 1.0077%, nulls_key_10pct_over_limit 10.0539%. Policy outcome: nulls_0pct_nonkey ESCALATE (AP-6), nulls_5pct_nonkey ESCALATE (AP-6), nulls_20pct_nonkey ESCALATE (AP-6), nulls_50pct_nonkey ESCALATE (AP-6). Over the 5% limit (nulls_key_10pct_over_limit, 10.0539% of rows): 1 approval requested and the run paused in APPROVAL_REQUIRED with its output uncommitted. Clauses: pr_auc_monotone=False, rows_balanced=True, key_nulls_quarantined=True, nonkey_nulls_cost_no_rows=True, no_approval_under_limit=True, paused_over_limit=True.
limitations: The word 'imputed' in the PRD hypothesis is not measured as such: cleaning does not impute, the model pipeline does. What is measured is that non-key nulls do not cost rows.

nulls_key_10pct_over_limit is not one of the PRD's conditions. It was added, from the policy's 5% limit and before any run, because no PRD condition reaches that limit, so the expected observation about approval could not otherwise be observed.

The test PR-AUC moved from 0.6338 to 0.6351, inside both estimates' 95% intervals ([0.5875, 0.6817] and [0.5905, 0.6841]) on about 1366 test rows: the direction of the trend is measured, its size is not distinguished from sampling noise.
